objective: Explain how an employer can fund a work stream and follow evidence through certification.
audience: Developers evaluating an Arc testnet integration

format.safeArea: Keep all copy 8 mm inside trim; reserve the lower-right corner for a QR code.

copy.headline: Evidence in. Certification on-chain.
copy.subhead: ProofStream connects external work evidence to a USDC work stream.
copy.body: An off-chain attestor evaluates evidence, obtains an independent verifier opinion, and submits a signed attestation. The WorkStream contract enforces its configured payee, nonce, expiry, and policy limits.
disclaimers: AI judgment is an off-chain trust assumption; certification is only final after a successful on-chain receipt.

sourceClaims.claim: ProofStream is an Arc-based USDC work-stream system.
The attestor obtains an independent verifier opinion and submits a signed attestation.

visual.typography: Departure Mono for state labels and identifiers; readable proportional fallback for explanatory copy.
visual.safeArea: Use a 4 px rhythm and hard down-right shadow; keep all copy clear of trim and QR code.
